flow: Infectious Homosexual Men->AIDS living with AIDS
Infectious Heterosexual Men->AIDS living with AIDS
Treated with ART->AIDS living with AIDS
param: Ψ Total recruitment rate into the susceptible population per year. Corresponds to C in the paper.
θ Proportion of new recruits that are men. Corresponds to h in the paper.
γ Proportion of men that are heterosexual. Corresponds to c in the paper.
μ Natural mortality rate. Corresponds to l in the paper (1/77.3 years).
α Departure rate from the infectious compartments (progression to treatment or AIDS). Corresponds to a in the paper.
p Proportion of individuals departing from infectious classes who enroll in ART.
δ Rate of AIDS development in treated individuals due to ART resistance or failure.
d HIV/AIDS-induced mortality rate. Corresponds to d in the paper (1/3 years).
β_h Effective contact rate for HIV transmission between homosexual men.
β_s Effective contact rate for HIV transmission between heterosexual men and women.
β_{hw} Effective contact rate for HIV transmission from homosexual men to women.
β_{hm} Effective contact rate for HIV transmission from homosexual men to heterosexual men.
Ψ_h Recruitment rate for susceptible homosexual men.
Ψ_w Recruitment rate for susceptible women.
Ψ_m Recruitment rate for susceptible heterosexual men.
α_T Rate of progression from infectious to treated.
α_A Rate of progression from infectious to AIDS (untreated).
